## Convert Images

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>progress</span></div>

Convert images between PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP, TIFF, ICO, TGA, QOI and more, in bulk.

```sh
dogubako image convert <files…> [options]
```

Id `image.convert` · MCP `image_convert` · Output: files · Timeout 10 min

Also found by: convert, format, png to jpg, jpg to png, webp, avif, heic, batch, transcode

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | files |  | Images. Accepts image/\*, .png .jpg .jpeg .webp .gif .bmp +31 more. |
| `format` | `--format` | choice | `png` | Output format. One of: `png`, `jpg` (JPEG), `webp`, `avif`, `gif`, `bmp`, `tiff`, `ico` (ICO (max 256px)), `tga`, `qoi`, `ppm` (PPM/PNM), `heic` (HEIC (ImageMagick)), `jxl` (JPEG XL (ImageMagick)), `jp2` (JPEG 2000 (ImageMagick)), `psd` (PSD (ImageMagick)). |
| `quality` | `--quality` | integer 1–100 | `85` | Quality for lossy formats (JPEG, WebP, AVIF), 1–100. Only used when `format` is one of `jpg`, `webp`, `avif`, `heic`, `jxl`, `jp2`. |
| `lossless` | `--lossless` | boolean | `false` | Lossless WebP encoding. Only used when `format` is `webp`. |
| `background` | `--background` | color | `#ffffff` | Background used when flattening transparency (e.g. PNG → JPEG). *Advanced.* |

## Resize Images

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>progress</span></div>

Resize images in bulk by width, height or percentage with contain/cover/fill/exact fit modes.

```sh

```

Id `image.resize` · MCP `image_resize` · Output: files · Timeout 10 min

Also found by: resize, scale, shrink, enlarge, dimensions, batch, downscale

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | files |  | Images. Accepts image/\*, .png .jpg .jpeg .webp .gif .bmp +31 more. |
| `width` | `--width` | integer 1–100000 |  | Target width in pixels. |
| `height` | `--height` | integer 1–100000 |  | Target height in pixels. |
| `percent` | `--percent` | number 0.1–10000 |  | Scale by percentage instead of pixel size. |
| `fit` | `--fit` | choice | `contain` | How to fit when both width and height are given. One of: `contain` (Contain (fit inside, keep aspect)), `cover` (Cover (fill box, crop overflow)), `fill` (Fill (fit inside, pad to exact size)), `exact` (Exact (stretch to size)). |
| `filter` | `--filter` | choice | `lanczos` | One of: `lanczos` (Lanczos (sharpest)), `bicubic`, `bilinear`, `gaussian`, `nearest` (Nearest neighbor (pixel art)). *Advanced.* |
| `no_upscale` | `--no-upscale` | boolean | `false` | Never make images larger than the original. |
| `format` | `--format` | choice | `same` | Output format. One of: `same` (Same as input), `png`, `jpg` (JPEG), `webp`, `avif`, `gif`, `bmp`, `tiff`, `ico` (ICO (max 256px)), `tga`, `qoi`, `ppm` (PPM/PNM), `heic` (HEIC (ImageMagick)), `jxl` (JPEG XL (ImageMagick)), `jp2` (JPEG 2000 (ImageMagick)), `psd` (PSD (ImageMagick)). *Advanced.* |
| `quality` | `--quality` | integer 1–100 | `85` | Quality for lossy formats (JPEG, WebP, AVIF), 1–100. *Advanced.* |
| `background` | `--background` | color | `#ffffff` | Padding color for 'fill' and flattening for JPEG. *Advanced.* |
